evidence.summary: Mt Van Hoevenberg news post on expanded community ski programs for the 2025-26 winter season (snippet).

comment: Same place as Mt Van Hoevenberg, Lake Placid. Official site mtvanhoevenberg.com returned 403, so officialUrl is null.

evidence.summary: Trail conditions page shows spring skiing report 3/29/26; season closed 3/30/26; ski sales posted 11/9/26 before opening.

comment: Resort site shows 26/27 passes for downhill only; no cross-country mention found. No closure evidence either.

evidence.summary: Live DCNR winter page for Patton park lists four marked cross-country ski trails, seven miles.

comment: School Nordic team races at Gore Mountain; campus trail system is undated and ski use unconfirmed. Town winter page does not list it.

evidence.summary: Patrol club page covers Roaring Run trails in Forbes State Forest, weekend ski-season patrols, no fees; page shows 2026 copyright.

comment: Ungroomed trails; Forbes State Forest ski page does not name Roaring Run.

evidence.summary: Live DNR page for Savage Highlands State Park lists Cabin Loop trail for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing.
State forest page lists about nine miles of free cross-country ski trails near the lodge.

comment: Lodge closed as a business after state purchase (2024) and is now Savage Highlands State Park. Old savageriverlodge.com domain now serves unrelated spam and redirects, so not used.

evidence.summary: Home page sells 2026-2027 winter trail season pass for cross-country skiing and snowshoeing, early-bird until November 30.
TART Trails page lists groomed and ungroomed cross-country skiing on Vasa Pathway; grooming under DNR and county agreement.
TART Trails grooming FAQ says Vasa Pathway is groomed, aiming four grooms weekly when conditions allow.

comment: Timber Ridge resort site shows no ski info; trail system is the Vasa Pathway, which links to Timber Ridge (snippet). Likely same trail system as vasa-pathway-bunker-hill-mi.
